text.description_html:
RK International White Porcelain Knob with Metal Tip

The 1 Inch White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center has a clean look. Pair with either a polished brass rose or a polished chrome rose for a retro feel. It is easy to install as it comes with the mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: 1-1/4" White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center and 1" Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center

Specifications and Features of the RK International 1" White Porcelain Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: porcelain with brass steam
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
